meaning.en: To coexist peacefully and in balance.

examples.zh: 人与自然应该和谐共存。
examples.en: People and nature should live together in harmony.

examples.zh: 不同文化在这座城市里和谐共存。
examples.en: Different cultures coexist harmoniously in this city.

examples.zh: 新旧建筑和谐共存，别有韵味。
examples.en: Old and new buildings sit together in harmony, with a charm of their own.

usage.en: Common in writing on ecology and multiculturalism.
usage.zh: 多用于谈生态、多元文化。

examples.zh: 这些家具都是老师傅精工细作的。
examples.en: This furniture was all meticulously made by master craftsmen.

examples.zh: 产品要精工细作，才能赢得口碑。
examples.en: Products must be finely made to earn a good name.

examples.zh: 这件刺绣精工细作，令人赞叹。
examples.en: The embroidery is exquisitely worked and amazing to see.

usage.en: For crafts, food and products; also 精耕细作 in farming.
usage.zh: 多用于手工艺、产品；农业上说“精耕细作”。

meaning.zh: 技术和本领远远超过一般人。

examples.zh: 这位厨师技艺超群，菜做得出神入化。
examples.en: The chef is outstandingly skilled; his dishes are sublime.

examples.zh: 她技艺超群，在比赛中夺得金牌。
examples.en: Her superior skill won her the gold medal.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise for craftspeople, athletes, performers.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，称赞手艺人、运动员、演员。

text: 师傅领进门，修行在个人
pinyin: shī fu lǐng jìn mén, xiū xíng zài gè rén
variants: 师父领进门，修行在个人
literal: master · leads · into · door · practice · lies · in · individual
natural: the master shows you the door; the practice is up to you

meaning.en: A teacher can only get you started; real progress depends on your own effort.
meaning.zh: 老师只能引导入门，学得好坏要靠自己努力。

equivalents: teachers open the door, but you must enter by yourself
you get out what you put in

examples.zh: 师傅领进门，修行在个人，以后就看你自己了。
examples.en: I've shown you the way in; from now on it's up to you.

examples.zh: 同一个老师教，成绩却差别很大，真是师傅领进门，修行在个人。
examples.en: Same teacher, very different results — the teacher can only start you off.

examples.zh: 老话说“师傅领进门”，剩下的路要自己走。
examples.en: As the saying goes, the master leads you to the door; the rest of the road is yours.

usage.en: The first half alone is common. Also written 师父.
usage.zh: 常只说前半句；“师傅”也写作“师父”。

literal: pass on · the Way · impart · learning
natural: teach the Way and pass on knowledge

meaning.en: To teach principles and pass on knowledge, the core of a teacher's role.
meaning.zh: 传授道理和学业，指教师的职责。

examples.zh: 老师传道授业，培养了一代又一代学生。
examples.en: Teachers pass on knowledge, educating generation after generation.

examples.zh: 他退休后依然传道授业，带了很多徒弟。
examples.en: Even after retiring he kept teaching and took on many apprentices.

examples.zh: 传道授业解惑，是为人师者的本分。
examples.en: Teaching, imparting knowledge and resolving doubts are a teacher's duty.

story.en: Han Yu's essay 'On Teachers' defines a teacher as 'one who passes on the Way, imparts learning and resolves doubts' (师者，所以传道受业解惑也).
story.zh: 韩愈《师说》：“师者，所以传道受业解惑也。”

usage.en: Often in praise of teachers (Teachers' Day). Full phrase 传道授业解惑.
usage.zh: 多用于赞美教师，全句“传道授业解惑”。

meaning.en: To get up at the first crow of the rooster; to be diligent.
meaning.zh: 鸡一叫就起床，形容勤奋。

examples.zh: 祖父一辈子鸡鸣而起，从不睡懒觉。
examples.en: Grandfather rose at cockcrow all his life and never slept in.

examples.zh: 为了备考，他每天鸡鸣而起背单词。
examples.en: To prepare for exams, he gets up at dawn to learn vocabulary.

story.en: Mencius: 'He who rises at cockcrow and diligently does good is a follower of Shun' (鸡鸣而起，孳孳为善者，舜之徒也).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“鸡鸣而起，孳孳为善者，舜之徒也。”

usage.en: Literary; praise for diligence. Compare 闻鸡起舞.
usage.zh: 书面语，称赞勤奋，参看“闻鸡起舞”。

natural: settle parents at night, greet them at dawn

meaning.en: To care for one's parents attentively morning and evening; filial devotion.
meaning.zh: 早晚向父母问安，指子女孝顺侍奉父母。

examples.zh: 古人讲究晨昏定省，孝敬父母。
examples.en: The ancients valued greeting their parents morning and night.

examples.zh: 如今工作忙，不能晨昏定省，也要常打电话回家。
examples.en: With busy jobs we can't wait on our parents daily, but we should call home often.

story.en: The Book of Rites: 'A son should keep his parents warm in winter and cool in summer, settle them at dusk and greet them at dawn' (昏定而晨省).
story.zh: 《礼记·曲礼上》：“凡为人子之礼，冬温而夏凊，昏定而晨省。”

usage.en: 省 is read xǐng (to visit) here. Literary.

meaning.en: The cold, desolate wind of late autumn; a bleak scene.
meaning.zh: 秋风吹得草木凋零，景象凄凉。

examples.zh: 秋风萧瑟，落叶满地。
examples.en: The bleak autumn wind blew and leaves covered the ground.

examples.zh: 秋风萧瑟中，他独自站在江边。
examples.en: In the chill autumn wind, he stood alone by the river.

examples.zh: 生意进入淡季，市场一片秋风萧瑟。
examples.en: In the off-season the market looks bleak.

story.en: Cao Cao, gazing at the sea from Mount Jieshi, wrote: 'The autumn wind is bleak, and great waves surge up' (秋风萧瑟，洪波涌起).
story.zh: 曹操登碣石山观海，写下“秋风萧瑟，洪波涌起”。

usage.en: Literary; also figurative for slumping markets.
usage.zh: 书面语，也比喻市场冷清。

meaning.en: Mild and pleasant all year round.
meaning.zh: 一年四季都像春天一样温暖。

examples.zh: 昆明四季如春，被称为“春城”。
examples.en: Kunming is spring-like all year and is called the 'City of Spring'.

examples.zh: 室内装了暖气，四季如春。
examples.en: With heating installed, it's like spring indoors all year.

usage.en: Classic description of Kunming and other mild places.
usage.zh: 常用来形容昆明等地气候。

natural: an age of peace and prosperity

meaning.zh: 社会安定、繁荣昌盛的时代。

equivalents: an era of peace and plenty

examples.zh: 生在太平盛世，我们要珍惜和平。
examples.en: Born in an age of peace and plenty, we should treasure peace.

examples.zh: 盛世太平，百姓安居乐业。
examples.en: In this peaceful, flourishing age, people live and work contentedly.

examples.zh: 唐朝贞观年间被誉为太平盛世。
examples.en: The Zhenguan era of the Tang is celebrated as a golden age.

usage.en: Also 盛世太平. Often in festive greetings and historical writing.
usage.zh: 也作“盛世太平”，常见于祝福、史书。

antonyms: 中华民族到了最危险的时候
先帝创业未半而中道崩殂，今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也
山河破碎风飘絮，身世浮沉雨打萍

examples.zh: 求学阶段，应当寸阴是惜。
examples.en: While studying, you should make every minute count.

examples.zh: 他寸阴是惜，连坐车时都在看书。
examples.en: He treasures every moment and even reads on the bus.

usage.en: Literary inverted object (是 marks the fronted object, like 唯利是图). 寸阴 is the time the sun's shadow takes to move an inch.
usage.zh: 书面语，宾语前置。“寸阴”指日影移动一寸的时间。

story.en: The Book of Jin says the general Tao Kan used to say that even the sage Yu "treasured every inch of shadow" (大禹圣者，乃惜寸阴), so ordinary people should treasure every minute.
story.zh: 《晋书·陶侃传》记陶侃常说：“大禹圣者，乃惜寸阴；至于众人，当惜分阴。”

meaning.zh: 极短的时间也价值千金，形容时间宝贵。

examples.zh: 考前复习一刻千金，别再玩手机了。
examples.en: Revision time before the exam is precious; stop playing on your phone.

examples.zh: 春宵一刻值千金。
examples.en: A spring night's moment is worth a thousand in gold.

examples.zh: 比赛最后几分钟一刻千金。
examples.en: The last few minutes of the match are priceless.

story.en: Su Shi's quatrain opens: 'A moment of a spring night is worth a thousand in gold' (春宵一刻值千金).
story.zh: 苏轼《春宵》：“春宵一刻值千金，花有清香月有阴。”

usage.en: Shortened from Su Shi's line 春宵一刻值千金.
usage.zh: 由苏轼诗句“春宵一刻值千金”缩略而来。

meaning.en: Capturing both outward appearance and inner spirit (of art).
meaning.zh: 外形和神韵都很好，多指艺术作品。

equivalents: true to life in look and spirit

examples.zh: 这幅画中的马形神兼备。
examples.en: The horses in this painting capture both form and spirit.

examples.zh: 他的表演形神兼备，把人物演活了。
examples.en: His performance captured the character inside and out.

examples.zh: 这尊雕像神形兼备，栩栩如生。
examples.en: The statue is true in form and spirit, as if alive.

usage.en: Art criticism; also 神形兼备.
usage.zh: 多用于艺术评论，也作“神形兼备”。

meaning.en: To amaze everyone present with one's skill.
meaning.zh: 技艺使在场的人都很吃惊。

examples.zh: 这位少年钢琴家技惊四座。
examples.en: The young pianist wowed the audience.

examples.zh: 他在晚会上露了一手魔术，技惊四座。
examples.en: He did a magic trick at the party and stunned everyone.

usage.en: Modelled on 语惊四座 / 满座皆惊.

meaning.en: Stiff and unnatural, obviously put on.

examples.zh: 他的表演生硬做作，观众出戏了。
examples.en: His acting was wooden and pulled the audience out of the story.

examples.zh: 这段对话写得生硬做作。
examples.en: This dialogue is stilted and forced.

usage.en: Criticism of acting, writing and manners.
usage.zh: 多用于批评表演、文字、举止。

meaning.en: To fail to grasp the main point.
meaning.zh: 抓不住关键，没有掌握要点。

equivalents: not get the hang of it

examples.zh: 他讲了半天，我还是不得要领。
examples.en: He talked for ages and I still didn't get the point.

examples.zh: 学游泳一直不得要领，总是沉下去。
examples.en: I just can't get the hang of swimming; I keep sinking.

examples.zh: 这篇文章写得冗长，不得要领。
examples.en: The article is long-winded and misses the point.

story.en: Zhang Qian travelled to the Yuezhi to win them as allies against the Xiongnu, but 'in the end could not get the Yuezhi's key point' (竟不能得月氏要领) — they had no interest — and returned empty-handed.
story.zh: 张骞出使月氏，想联合月氏夹击匈奴，“竟不能得月氏要领”，无功而返。

usage.en: 要领 originally 'waist and collar', the parts by which a garment is held, hence 'key point'.
usage.zh: “要”同“腰”，“领”为衣领，引申为关键。

text: 工欲善其事，必先利其器
pinyin: gōng yù shàn qí shì, bì xiān lì qí qì
literal: craftsman · wants · do well · his · work · must · first · sharpen · his · tools
natural: a craftsman must first sharpen his tools

meaning.en: Good preparation and good tools are needed to do a job well.
meaning.zh: 要做好工作，先要准备好工具。

equivalents: a good workman needs good tools

examples.zh: 工欲善其事，必先利其器，先把电脑配置好吧。
examples.en: A good workman needs good tools — let's set up the computer first.

examples.zh: 学外语也是工欲善其事，选一本好词典很重要。
examples.en: Learning a language is the same: you need a good dictionary first.

examples.zh: 老话说“工欲善其事”，准备工作不能马虎。
examples.en: As the saying goes, sharpen your tools first; don't skimp on preparation.

story.en: Asked how to practise humaneness, Confucius said: 'A craftsman who wants to do his work well must first sharpen his tools' — so serve the worthy and befriend the humane.
story.zh: 子贡问为仁，孔子说：“工欲善其事，必先利其器。”要先结交贤人仁者。

usage.en: The first half alone is common.

natural: swinging an axe like the wind

meaning.zh: 挥动斧头呼呼生风，比喻技艺纯熟高超。

examples.zh: 老木匠运斤成风，几下就把木头削平了。
examples.en: The old carpenter swung his axe with masterful skill and planed the wood in a few strokes.

examples.zh: 他的书法运斤成风，挥洒自如。
examples.en: His calligraphy has consummate, effortless skill.

story.en: A man of Ying smeared a speck of plaster thin as a fly's wing on his nose; Carpenter Shi swung his axe like the wind and sliced it off without harming him. Zhuangzi told the story mourning the death of his sparring partner Huizi.
story.zh: 郢人鼻尖上沾了薄如蝇翼的白灰，匠石“运斤成风”，削去白灰而鼻子毫发无伤。庄子借此悼念惠施。

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪
